key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:L/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: initialise_program_entry
description: Program entry point that sets fields of the state block from its counters and copies values between them. It writes two decimal digit characters into a text buffer and makes a series of indirect calls to the other routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:0000
name: clear_state_table_and_chain
description: Zeroes a block of 947 words at a base computed from a global index and stores a pointer and a value into the state block. It then calls the next routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:016E
name: open_system_libraries_and_font
description: Opens the graphics and layers libraries and the trackdisk device, then loads the Amber 9 font from FONTS. It returns a failure code when one of the opens fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:08BA
name: release_flagged_memory_blocks
description: Tests bits in two flag bytes and makes one library call per set bit, passing a stored pointer and a fixed size. This matches freeing memory blocks of known sizes when their flags are set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:0B36
name: build_six_entry_offset_table
description: Makes library calls to set up a 920-byte structure and clears a 16-bit field. It then walks six relative offsets, storing each entry's pointer and value in two arrays.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:0BCC
name: try_open_door_at_position
description: Tests the map tile at the given position and at neighbours four units to either side, returning zero when none matches. On a match it picks the 'It opened.' or 'It's locked.' message, which fits a door interaction.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:0EEE
name: initialise_game_screens
description: Large setup routine that calls twenty-two other routines and works with the hiscreen and page0 display buffers and the 'No Arrows!' text. It also compares values with AmigaDOS hunk type codes, so parts of it look like loader code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5716
name: record_position_and_delta
description: Takes an x value, a y value and a flag, stores the change from the previous position, and records the new position as the previous one. When the flag is nonzero it also stores a derived value, and three further routines are called.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:57FA
name: find_table_range_index
description: Masks a stored value to one byte and searches one of two byte tables for the entry at or below it, the table being chosen by a comparison with 8. It calls three other routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5B1C
name: update_stored_index_on_change
description: Reads a byte from a record and passes it to a library call, then compares a lookup-table value with a stored value. When they differ it stores the new value, sets a counter to three and makes further calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5B9E
name: compute_offset_coordinate_pair
description: Calls two routines to obtain values, then computes two coordinates from a stored position plus those values and 150. It stores the coordinates in two fields.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5BF0
name: derive_record_coordinates
description: Looks up a 22-byte record by index. When its type byte is 7 it uses fixed coordinate constants, otherwise it loops, calling a routine to build two coordinates from stored offsets.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5DE0
name: reset_record_if_idle
description: Finds a record through a lookup call and, when its counter is not positive and its state is neither 14 nor 15, resets its counter and two fields and sets its state to 14. It then makes a call with a fixed code that depends on the record's type.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5EAA
name: set_mode_and_offset
description: Sets a mode byte to six when the argument is ten and to five otherwise. When the argument differs from the stored value it stores it and calls three routines, then computes an offset from a lookup table plus 250.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:5F88
name: initialise_record_defaults
description: Stores a set of default constants into the state fields, including timing values and a threshold of 15000. It then calls three other routines to finish the setup.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:637C
name: set_scroll_positions_from_arg
description: Calls two routines and derives several position fields from its argument and a returned value, storing a fixed offset minus the argument and a second offset minus the returned value. One more routine is called to finish the update.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:642C
name: classify_position_against_bounds
description: Compares two stored 16-bit coordinates with fixed lower and upper bounds, returning 24 when a flag is zero. Outside the rectangle it checks further flags and the state before choosing a result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:6534
name: update_position_flags_and_call
description: When the state is below eight and a count is below ten, it masks two stored coordinates and calls another routine when they fall in a range. It then stores a value derived from the coordinate fields.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:6660
name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Swaps two stored buffer pointers, copies two longwords from the new buffer into state fields, and calls two library routines with addresses inside the state block. This matches flipping between two buffers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:66B6
name: open_input_device
description: Clears two flag bytes, allocates a request through a system call and then opens input.device. It stores the returned handle and a result code, and returns zero when the first allocation fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:6766
name: configure_input_request_and_send
description: Sets fields of an I/O request structure, including a value of 10 and a pointer, then makes four library calls on it. This fits sending a request to the input device.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:67AC
name: collect_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table of 18-byte records up to a stored count, and for each record with bit two set in its flag byte copies a value into an output buffer. It then calls one other routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:68CA
name: map_value_to_state_index
description: Reads a byte from a buffer by index and remaps it according to a mode value: 14 for mode 8, 13 for mode 9, 4 for small values, and a table lookup for mode 6 and others.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:6A66
name: dispatch_by_mode_state
description: Switches on a stored mode number and handles each case separately; the first case calls the same routine again with argument 8 for that value. Only part of its body is recovered, so the remaining cases are not described.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:7ED2
name: retry_until_status_five
description: Calls a routine on two stored values up to twenty-five times, stopping early when it returns five. If the loop runs out without that result, it makes a further call with a fixed argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:7F18
name: issue_two_step_position_call
description: Passes two stored coordinates to a routine with the value 1, then calls another routine with 5. It is a short wrapper for a two-step notification.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:7F40
name: set_mode_if_not_locked
description: When bit zero of a flag byte is clear, it stores the argument as a mode value, clears a related byte and calls one routine. When the bit is set it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:7F60
name: load_bytes_from_lookup_table
description: Fills two seven-entry byte tables from a lookup routine, one read from offset nine onward and one from offset zero, then fills a further table from entries starting at 16.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:800E
name: loop_until_counter_reaches_ten
description: Repeatedly calls one routine while a stored counter is below ten, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8022
name: update_record_fields_by_index
description: For a stored index below ten, compares a field of the selected 18-byte record with a stored value. When it differs it makes a call and stores the new value, then processes further fields of the same record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:82A0
name: call_scaled_entry_if_enabled
description: When bit zero of a flag byte is set, it calls one routine with a table entry and half of a stored value plus the argument. Otherwise it returns without action.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:82E0
name: initialise_three_buffers_and_pointer
description: Makes three calls that each act on a 35-unit buffer, stores a pointer chosen from a table by a stored index, and then makes a call on a 60-unit buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8334
name: store_stack_argument_field
description: Stores the first stack argument into offset four of an address register and returns. It is a one-line field writer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:833A
name: advance_record_state_machine
description: Loops over a record whose state byte it reads, and when the state is 1 it clears a field, writes a value into a table entry and calls two other routines. Part of its control flow is not recovered, so later states are not described.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8390
name: compare_and_copy_record_flags
description: Compares a flag word from two records and, when the bit pattern differs, copies a byte between them and calls another routine. Some control flow is not recovered in the decompiled output.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:83BC
name: map_screen_point_to_letter
description: Checks that a point falls inside fixed horizontal and vertical ranges, then converts its vertical offset into a letter code by dividing by nine and doubling. It calls a library routine, which fits a text or keyboard hit test.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:84EA
name: pop_byte_from_ring_buffer
description: Compares a read and write index pair for a 128-entry ring buffer and, when they differ, returns the next byte and advances the read index with wrap-around.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8514
name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Multiplies a stored 16-bit state by a constant, adds one and stores it back, then returns a value built from the new state. It is a linear congruential style random generator.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:852C
name: and_random_with_argument
description: Calls the random generator and returns its result ANDed with the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8534
name: random_flag_bit
description: Returns the low bit of a call to the random generator.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:853E
name: random_value_below_four
description: Returns the random generator output masked to its low two bits, giving a value from zero to three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8548
name: random_value_below_eight
description: Returns the random generator output masked to its low three bits, giving a value from zero to seven.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8552
name: random_value_up_to_63
description: Returns the random generator output masked to its low six bits, giving a value from zero to 63.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:855C
name: random_byte_value
description: Calls the random generator and returns its low byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8566
name: random_value_modulo_parameter
description: Calls the random generator and returns the low 16 bits of its value taken modulo the low 16 bits of the argument, alongside the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:857A
name: call_library_after_random
description: Calls the random generator, then calls a library routine through a pointer stored in a state field, and returns the input registers. The effect depends on that library entry, which is not named here.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:85A6
name: format_number_right_aligned
description: Writes a number into a ten-character field from the right, one decimal digit per position, and fills the leading positions with spaces when the number is shorter than the field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:85AE
name: write_number_with_space_padding
description: Writes a number as decimal digits from a starting position leftwards, stopping when the value reaches zero and filling the rest with spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:85CA
name: fill_remaining_with_spaces
description: Writes space characters from a starting position down to zero, clearing the rest of a text field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:85F6
name: nested_callback_loop
description: Runs three nested loops that call a set of routines through function pointers held relative to a stored base, with extra calls when the counter exceeds nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:86FA
name: step_through_text_with_library
description: Loops over a text pointer, calling two library routines through function pointers and advancing the pointer by a stored amount each time. The exact operation depends on those library calls, which are not named here.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:874E
name: position_bit_mask_from_stack
description: Builds a single-bit byte mask from bit tests on two stack arguments, then compares the scaled coordinates against a stored offset and returns the mask.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8756
name: position_bit_mask_from_registers
description: Builds a single-bit byte mask from bit tests on two register arguments, then compares the scaled coordinates against a stored offset and returns the mask. It is the register-argument form of its neighbour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:87EE
name: decrement_stack_counter_by_four
description: Calls one library routine through a pointer stored in the state block, then decrements a counter field by four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8810
name: subtract_block_size_from_counter
description: Calls the same library routine as its neighbour, then subtracts a stored size plus four from a counter field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8838
name: run_fixed_call_sequence
description: Makes one call with a stored value and then a long run of identical no-argument calls to the same routine. It appears to be a fixed sequence of updates.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:88F0
name: run_six_update_calls
description: Makes six calls to the same routine in sequence and then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:890A
name: copy_sixteen_word_rows
description: Copies rows of sixteen 16-bit words from a source derived from its arguments into destination buffers, using register-offset addresses.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8964
name: stub_empty_return
description: A routine containing only a return, with no effect and no recovered callers. It is a stub, so it does no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:896E
name: forward_stored_value_once
description: Calls one routine with a value taken from a stored state field and returns the unchanged input registers. It is a one-call wrapper.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:89C8
name: run_stored_value_call_sequence
description: Starts with a call using a stored state field, then makes a long sequence of further no-argument calls to the same routine and returns the input registers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8A62
name: forward_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no data manipulation of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8A70
name: update_block_offsets_from_state
description: Reads two stored state fields and combines them with its two arguments by arithmetic, storing the results before calling one routine. The exact layout is not fully recovered from the decompiled output.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8B30
name: walk_word_records_updating_fields
description: Walks a set of 16-bit word records reached through pointers stored in the state block, updating several of their fields and calling one other routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8BC8
name: write_tile_words_at_row
description: Computes two destination addresses from its arguments using a 64-byte row stride and two base pointers held in the state block, then writes words to them. This looks like placing a tile row.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8C18
name: compute_wrapped_tile_index
description: Converts two screen positions to tile coordinates by shifting them and subtracting stored origin values, wrapping each within its range, and returns a combined index.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8C84
name: scan_tile_table_at_position
description: Uses the same stored origins as its neighbour to convert its arguments to tile offsets, then scans a word table and updates its entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8D48
name: expand_run_length_bytes
description: When a flag byte is nonzero, reads a byte-coded sequence in which negative values are negated to give run lengths, expanding it into the output pointer. This matches a run-length decoder.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8DC4
name: scale_value_by_table_entry
description: When the selector is below eight, multiplies the second argument by a table entry chosen by the selector, halves the product and adds it to the first argument, keeping the result to fifteen bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8DEE
name: scale_value_keep_sign_bit
description: Applies the same table scaling as its neighbour, but keeps the sign bit of the first argument unchanged while the rest of the result is masked to fifteen bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E20
name: copy_bit14_to_sign_bit
description: Sets bit fifteen of a 16-bit value when bit fourteen is set and clears it otherwise. The remaining bits are unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E30
name: clear_sign_bit
description: Returns its 16-bit argument with the top bit cleared.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E36
name: adjust_offset_toward_target
description: Computes the scaled difference between two arguments and two stored offsets, then steps or clamps a stored horizontal offset toward the target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E6E
name: step_offset_x_by_one
description: Adjusts a stored horizontal offset by one step when the difference exceeds a dead zone of twenty, and otherwise sets it from a register value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E7E
name: step_offset_toward_difference
description: Steps a stored horizontal offset by one when the difference exceeds twenty in either direction, and steps or sets a vertical offset from another register with a dead zone of 24.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8E8A
name: step_offsets_toward_targets
description: Steps a stored horizontal offset when the difference is above twenty, and steps a stored vertical offset by one inside a dead-zone band or sets it from a register value at the outer bound.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8EA4
name: step_vertical_offset_toward_target
description: Moves a stored vertical offset by one step when the difference lies outside a dead zone of ten, and sets it from a register value when the difference reaches 45 or more.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8EB4
name: step_vertical_offset_by_one
description: Moves a stored vertical offset by one toward the difference when it lies outside a dead zone of ten in either direction.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8EC0
name: increment_vertical_offset_above_ten
description: Adds one to a stored vertical offset when the difference is above ten, and otherwise leaves it unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8ED6
name: report_error_if_not_two
description: When the argument is not two, it calls three routines with constant coordinates, a global text pointer and the argument. The ERROR text is referenced, so the routine reports an error condition.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8F0E
name: classify_argument_into_band
description: Looks up a byte in a table by the argument, then grades the argument into bands with nested range checks and returns the band value with the register value. The band thresholds are only partly visible in the output.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8F5A
name: read_joystick_direction_delta
description: Reads the joystick port movement bits and derives horizontal and vertical deltas from them. The result is returned as two values, and a stored state word gates the calculation.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8F6E
name: read_joystick_with_held_state
description: Reads the joystick port movement bits as its neighbour does, then calls two routines to combine the movement with a stored state before returning.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:8FC0
name: read_joystick_movement_state
description: Reads the joystick port data register bits to derive a movement value. When both deltas are zero it returns a stored state word, otherwise it calls two routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9012
name: clamp_index_to_zero_nine
description: Subtracts twenty from a stored value, clamps it to the range zero to nine, and calls one routine with the new value when it changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9026
name: reset_index_to_nine
description: Clears a stored index to zero, then sets it to nine and calls one routine with nine when the previous value was not nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9044
name: probe_twice_with_range_checks
description: Calls one routine and, when its short result is neither one nor at least ten, calls it again and returns zero if that second result is neither one nor at least eight. Otherwise it returns the first result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9080
name: combine_source_words_into_dest
description: Runs a nested loop over a region sized by its arguments, reading source words through pointers and writing a combined result into the destination. The exact bitwise combination is not fully visible in the excerpt.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9112
name: run_blitter_copy_for_planes
description: Waits for the blitter with a library call, then loops over four plane pointers, programming the blitter source, destination, modulo and size registers for each one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:91A2
name: program_blitter_destination_and_size
description: Writes fixed control values to the blitter registers, sets the destination pointer and the blitter size from its arguments, and returns zero. It programs one blitter operation.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:91CC
name: blit_all_planes_with_wait
description: Loops over four bitplane pointers, waiting for the blitter through a library call before programming its source, destination, modulo, control and size registers for each plane.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9286
name: blit_single_plane_with_offset
description: Checks the blitter busy bit and waits through a library call when needed, then programs the blitter pointer, modulo and size registers using a stored offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9310
name: blit_planes_from_argument_offset
description: Loops over four bitplane pointers, waiting on the blitter when it is busy, and programs its registers for each plane using an offset supplied by the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9390
name: blit_four_planes_by_table
description: Loops over four bitplane pointers held in a table, waiting on the blitter when busy, and programs its registers for each plane from stored values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9414
name: dispatch_through_unrecovered_jump
description: Makes an indirect call through a stored vector, and the decompiler could not recover its jump table. The target routine is therefore unknown from this entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:94F2
name: call_vector_unrecovered_target
description: Makes an indirect call through a stored vector whose jump table the decompiler could not recover, so the callee is unknown from this entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9BEC
name: lookup_record_flags_for_index
description: Finds a 22-byte record by index and, unless the fourth argument is six, takes a value from that record before returning a combined result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9BF6
name: lookup_record_value_and_call
description: Finds a 22-byte record by index, takes a value from it as its neighbour does, and makes one further call before returning.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9C32
name: compute_signed_step_direction
description: Negates a value and selects a sign from the second argument to build a signed step, then calls one routine. It forms a directional movement step.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9C40
name: compute_step_with_clamp
description: Computes a signed step from its arguments, clamping it against half of a second value, and calls routines to finish the movement. It is a larger version of its neighbour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9CAA
name: set_random_direction_field
description: Uses a random call to decide whether to negate a stored value, then stores the sum of two values masked to three bits into a record field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9CB8
name: store_direction_difference
description: Stores the difference of two byte values masked to three bits into a record field, and sets a second field to 12 unless the state value is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9CD4
name: try_activate_actor_slot
description: Checks a counter and a table entry, using random values, to decide whether an actor slot is free, then calls two routines with its arguments. The game meaning of the slot is not established here.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9D3A
name: check_actor_slot_then_update
description: Looks up a slot type byte and returns early unless it matches neither of two reserved values, then calls two routines to update the slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9D70
name: subtract_record_value_from_counter
description: Subtracts a field of a record from a stored counter at the index given by a lookup, then calls routines to check and update the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9DC4
name: place_random_offset_by_case
description: Chooses one of two base offsets depending on its state arguments, adds a random value from zero to 511, and calls a routine with the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9DE8
name: place_random_offset_alternate
description: Adds a random value from zero to 511 to a base of 800 or 400 depending on its state argument, then calls routines with the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9E06
name: place_random_offset_then_check
description: Makes a call with a random offset added to 400, then checks several table entries and calls further routines depending on the values found.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9E7A
name: count_type_two_entries
description: Loops from index three up to a stored limit, counting table entries whose value is two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9E8A
name: count_matching_slot_pairs
description: Loops over table entries, counting those of type two whose companion entry equals fifteen, and returns the count through its counter registers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9EA0
name: count_entries_of_type_fifteen
description: Counts table entries marked fifteen and, for other entries, checks a companion entry against five before counting it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9EB8
name: count_entries_of_type_five
description: Counts table entries marked five, then runs a loop over a further counter up to the limit, calling three routines along the way.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9EE4
name: display_bravely_done_message
description: Prints the 'Bravely done!' message through a call with the global text pointer when a stored value is low and a flag is set. Otherwise it takes a counter path and calls several routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9EFC
name: report_battle_outcome_text
description: Chooses between the 'foes fled in retreat.' and 'foes were defeated in battle.' messages from flags and a stored counter, and calls routines to show the chosen text.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:9FA2
name: check_pair_slot_and_compute
description: Returns early unless two table entries for the given index are both of type two, then calls a routine to compute a result and tests a stored counter before returning the status.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A010
name: scan_slots_skipping_reserved
description: Scans slot indices up to a stored limit, skipping a reserved index, and returns zero when it reaches the limit. It calls one routine to test each slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A016
name: scan_slots_for_type_five
description: Loops over slots, skipping reserved indices and slots whose type is five, and calls two routines to examine each remaining slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A0BA
name: advance_to_next_eligible_slot
description: Advances an index through the slots until it finds one that is neither the current slot nor index one, returning zero when it runs past the limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A0CE
name: scan_slots_for_flagged_entry
description: Walks slot indices from one up to a stored limit, clearing a counter and testing each slot type with a routine, and returns the second argument when the scan finishes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A0DE
name: count_slots_of_type_one
description: Loops over slots, and for each slot of type one checks a field of the associated record and calls a routine to update the count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A142
name: compare_slot_coordinates
description: Looks up two 16-bit values for an index and compares their difference against a threshold, calling a routine when the values are close or far apart. It returns a status code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A1C0
name: call_pair_when_within_double
description: Calls two routines when the second argument is no greater than twice the first, and otherwise returns without calling them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A1CC
name: call_pair_of_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A1DE
name: test_record_against_point
description: Looks up a record by index and passes its two coordinates with the other arguments to two routines, returning a boolean result from the comparison.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A26C
name: store_pair_into_record
description: Writes two 16-bit values into the coordinate fields of the record selected by an index field, then returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A290
name: copy_entry_fields_from_table
description: Reads four bytes for an index from a table of four-byte entries, copies them into a second table, and calls routines to apply them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A368
name: configure_mode_dependent_values
description: Sets a series of state fields depending on a mode value, with a different set of constants for each mode, and calls routines with the arguments. It is a long multi-case configuration routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A56E
name: fill_table_with_random_values
description: Fills word table entries with values from the random generator masked to twelve bits, then calls a routine to finish the table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A5CA
name: dequeue_event_from_ring
description: Compares the head and tail indices of a 32-entry ring and, when they differ, reads the entry at the tail and advances it. When the queue is empty it calls one routine with 1.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A5E8
name: dispatch_queued_event
description: Takes the next queued entry, advances the index with wrap-around at 32, and dispatches on its type through a switch. Type two calls a routine with a fixed code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A7F0
name: dispatch_event_case_two
description: Switches on a numeric argument and, for case two, makes several library calls with fixed values to update two fields. The other cases are not visible in the excerpt.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A870
name: enqueue_event_if_not_full
description: Advances a write index through a 32-entry ring and, unless the ring is full, stores the argument at the new position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A89E
name: print_string_at_position
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, then draws it through routine calls with fixed positional constants and the string length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A8B6
name: setup_text_window_layout
description: Makes a series of routine calls with fixed positional constants, including 400 and 44, and library calls through graphics vectors. It sets up a text window or output area.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A8F8
name: print_string_with_length
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and passes it with its length to one routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A910
name: forward_to_library_vector_60
description: Forwards to a library routine at offset minus 60 and returns. Its body is a single call, so it adds no logic of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A922
name: copy_text_into_scratch_buffer
description: Copies characters from its argument into a fixed text buffer one at a time until the end marker, then stores the buffer position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A942
name: split_text_at_spaces
description: Copies characters from an input text one at a time, marking a word boundary at each space. It works as a word splitter for a text buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A97C
name: expand_percent_placeholders
description: Scans text for percent signs and, when one is found, substitutes a string from a pointer table indexed by a stored counter, copying the result into an output buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A9AE
name: copy_chars_until_counter_limit
description: Increments a stored counter and copies characters from the source pointer while the counter is below 37, writing them to the output buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A9B0
name: append_char_to_output_buffer
description: Appends a character to a text output buffer by advancing the stored write pointer, then checks for a line or length limit and calls routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:A9F6
name: terminate_output_string
description: Writes a zero terminator at the current output position and advances the write pointer, then checks the length against 38 and calls routines to flush the text.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AA20
name: stub_empty_return
description: A routine containing only a return, with no effect and no recovered callers. It is a stub, so it does no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AA28
name: copy_message_text_by_index
description: Walks a message table, skipping zero-terminated entries until the requested index is reached, then copies the chosen message into the output.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AA32
name: copy_message_from_second_table
description: Uses the same string-table indexing as its neighbour, but over a second message table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AA3C
name: skip_strings_to_index
description: Advances a text pointer past a given number of zero-terminated strings and returns the new position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AA56
name: print_search_result_message
description: Prints a result message built from a table entry, the 'containing' and 'found' text, and the argument, using a sequence of routine calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AAAA
name: print_found_message
description: Prints a short message built from a table entry, the 'found' text and the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AAE6
name: print_table_entry_text
description: Looks up a text entry in a table by a stored index and passes it to one routine for display.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AB06
name: initialise_text_block_and_open
description: Initialises a text block pointer and a value taken from a linked structure, then calls library routines to set the block up. It appears to open a text or display object.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AB70
name: configure_block_and_flag
description: Points a stored pointer at a block, stores a fixed word value, calls two routines, and stores a byte value of three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AB92
name: loop_down_by_fives_drawing
description: Loops from 100 down in steps of five, calling one routine with the step value and a buffer pointer, and calls another routine with one on each pass.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:ABC4
name: loop_up_by_fives_drawing
description: Loops from zero up to 100 in steps of five, calling one routine with the step value and a buffer pointer, and calls another routine with one on each pass.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:ABFA
name: clear_fields_then_call
description: Clears two 16-bit fields of a structure reached through a global pointer and then calls one routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AC1A
name: run_indexed_call_sequence
description: Stores a value from a state field and then makes a fixed sequence of calls with small index arguments, including one based on a count minus one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AC9C
name: update_table_from_randoms
description: Reads random values, doubles one of them and stores it into a table entry at an index, then continues with further table updates and calls. Part of its body is not visible in the excerpt.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AE0C
name: process_56_byte_record_entry
description: Selects a 56-byte record by index and, when its state field is two, makes a library call through the graphics vector. Other states are handled in the rest of the body.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AE8E
name: copy_fourteen_longs_to_table
description: Copies a block of fourteen 32-bit values from a source pointer into a fixed table in the state block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AEBA
name: forward_to_routine_once
description: Calls one routine and returns. It is a thin wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AEC6
name: dispatch_entry_from_table
description: Initialises a state block, clears one 16-bit field, then calls a routine with values from an 18-byte table entry selected by the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AF40
name: call_unless_state_two_done
description: When a record's state is two and a routine returns zero, it returns early. Otherwise it calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:AF66
name: load_song_index_entries
description: Opens a file named from a global string, which is referenced as 'songs', and reads 4-byte entries from it in a loop. It appears to load a song index.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B012
name: open_screen_with_fixed_geometry
description: When a flag is clear, makes a timing call and then a library call with fixed geometry values, including width 320 and height 200, to open a display. It sets up a screen rather than reading data.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B0A0
name: loop_over_twenty_two_slots
description: Loops 22 times, reading a value from a global structure on each pass and calling two routines with values derived from it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B364
name: test_space_key_pressed
description: Calls one routine to read a key or input code, stores whether it equals 32, the space character, in a flag, and returns that flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B386
name: allocate_or_copy_block
description: When the pointer argument is above a fixed high boundary, allocates a new block through a library call and copies the old contents across. It returns the resulting pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B3CC
name: initialise_game_display_state
description: Large setup routine that sets many state values from a structure and calls five library entries plus two routines. This fits initialising the display or graphics state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B70E
name: start_pointer_table_draw
description: Sets a stored field to two, then calls routines with a pointer and a table entry chosen by a stored state index, passing a fixed value of 128.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B770
name: copy_record_position_into_slot
description: Copies the position of a 22-byte record into a slot, adding ten to its vertical coordinate, and stores a flag byte from the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B7B2
name: check_flag_then_store_state
description: Looks up a flag byte for an index and, when its top bit is clear, stores the current state value and calls one routine with the second argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B7FA
name: mark_slot_if_type_fifteen
description: Looks up an entry for the current state index and, when its type byte is fifteen, updates a flag field in the same table. It calls one routine to find the entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B828
name: store_byte_at_offset_five
description: Writes a byte value into offset five of an address register. It is a single-store helper.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B834
name: fill_sprite_record_fields
description: Stores three arguments into state fields and builds a small record in a local buffer, then calls one routine to finish the setup.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B884
name: randomise_table_entries_with_flag
description: Loops over entries writing values derived from a random number masked to fourteen bits, combined with a flag bit from a stored value, and calls two routines to finish each entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:B98E
name: compute_sprite_bounds_from_position
description: Computes two offsets from a stored position with a fixed margin of minus eight, then checks flags on linked entries and calls five routines to apply them.
